subject: Pilot extension options — 1 week add-on vs ops-escrow credits
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@tailwindai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick — adding time or credits to pilot?

Hi Naomi,

Quick question from our side: we’re 2 weeks into the 3-week pilot and hit a blocker with our ingestion pipeline that slowed progress. We can’t finish the last eval scenarios without another week of service. Options we discussed internally:

- Add one extra week to the existing timebox (same scope)
- Buy a block of "burn" credits to cover additional token usage and run the remaining tests

Can you send a simple price for both paths and any implications for conversion discounts/credits if we decide to commit shortly after the pilot? Also, are there Ops/engineering hours you can attach to speed the onboarding (we might need some help on prefix caching tuning)?

Thanks — Elena
Elena Torres
VP Product, TailwindAI
elena@tailwindai.com
+1 (415) 555-0146

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@tailwindai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick — adding time or credits to pilot?

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the note. Sorry to hear the ingestion hiccup — happy to get you across the finish line. Below are two clear options and a third hybrid we often use:

1) One-week timebox extension (same pilot variant)
   - Flat fee: $4,500 for an additional week of identical capacity and priority support
   - Converts to a 5% add-on credit if you convert to a Dedicated/Committed plan within 30 days of pilot end

2) Burn-credit pack (pay-as-you-go burst credits)
   - 50k token credit pack: $3,200 (usable immediately, no extension of calendar end-date)
   - Credits apply to hosted usage; can be consumed during the remaining days

3) Ops-escrow (recommended for fast unblock)
   - 8 hours of engineer time reserved and prioritized: $2,400 (sprint-style engagement, includes one 2-hour live session + follow-up notes)
   - We can combine with a smaller credit pack (25k tokens — $1,800) if you want both runway and hands-on help

Discounts/Conversion: if you pick option 1 or commit to a conversion call during the extension, we can offer a trial-conversion discount of 10% off the first-month committed rate (requires LOI/PO before the pilot end).

I attached a short quote and a breakdown of the Ops escrow scope. If you want, we can:
- Do the Ops session tomorrow afternoon (EAST window)
- Send a DocuSign for the selected option and a one-line SOW

Which direction do you want to take? Happy to put a short mutual action plan in place.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwoodinference.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick — adding time or credits to pilot?

Quick technical note from our side that might affect the commercial choice:

- If the blocker is prefix/KV-cache tuning, a focused Ops session (option 3) plus a small token pack usually yields the fastest path to meaningful results — you get both throughput improvements and headroom for reruns.
- Adding calendar days (option 1) is simplest contractually but sometimes encourages running broad experiments instead of focused remediation.

If it helps Elena, we can scope the 8-hour engagement into:
  - 2 hours onboarding + walkthrough of logs
  - 3 hours hands-on tuning and small model reruns
  - 3 hours result validation and one knowledge-transfer session

We’ll keep the internal notes on the caching changes if you proceed. Happy to join the Ops session.

— Rishi
Director, Solutions Engineering

From: Elena Torres <elena@tailwindai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks Naomi and Rishi — that breakdown is helpful. We’ll take the Ops-escrow (8 hours) + 25k token pack hybrid. A few practical asks:

- Can you send an invoice / one-line PO and the DocuSign link so procurement can approve today?
- We’d like the Ops session tomorrow at 11:00 PT if Rishi/Dev are available.
- Please confirm whether the 25k credits will carry over if we sign LOI within 30 days (our procurement lead asked).

If you can send the DocuSign and an invoice to procurement@tailwindai.com I’ll loop in finance and get the PO issued. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Elena
